SUBJECT: Places of Assembly - Plan Submission Requirements for
          the Use of Existing Exit Facilities


REFERENCE: Administrative Code Section 27-530, Means of Egress.
A Place of Assembly, located in a building classified in another
occupancy group, must comply with the exit requirements of
subchapter 8, but may use the exit facilities of the building of
which it is a part as a means of egress from the building.

PURPOSE:                 To establish additional guidelines for a plan(s)
submitted for a Place of Assembly which uses the existing exit
facilities of a building, and to insure that these facilities
provide a safe means of egress pursuant to Administrative Code
Section 27-354.

EFFECTIVE DATE: Immediately

SPECIFICS:  In addition to the information that shall be shown on
a Place of Assembly plan, the applicant shall be required to:

        1. Provide a diagrammatic or key plan of the entire floor
            on which the Place of Assembly is located. The key plan
            shall show the existing access and exit facilities, and
            identify those which will be used for egress by the
            Place of Assembly.    However, if the drawing submitted
            shows the entire floor plan, then a separate key plan is
            not mandatory.
PAGE 2



      2. Provide a diagrammatic or key plan(s) at the level or
          levels of exit discharge.    The key plan(s) shall show
          the continuous enclosure to discharge either directly or
          by way of a yard, court or exit passageway to an open
          exterior space.
